chunks: Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Hassan, from Abu Hashim al-Ja'fari, who said:

I prayed with Abu Ja'far (عليه السلام) in Masjid al-Musayyab, and he led us in salat in the place of the qiblah, evenly. And it was mentioned that the lote tree in the mosque had been dried up, with no leaves on it. So he called for water and prepared himself beneath the lote tree, and the lote tree came to life, put forth leaves, and bore fruit in that same year.

key_terms.السِّدْرَةَ: the lote tree mentioned in the mosque
key_terms.تَهَيَّأَ: prepared himself, here in the context of ritual preparation
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ الْمُسَيَّبِ: Masjid al-Musayyab, the mosque where this event took place
key_terms.مَوْضِعِ الْقِبْلَةِ: the place of the qiblah, the prayer-facing direction area

ai.seo_question: What happened to the dried lote tree when Abu Ja'far (عليه السلام) prayed in Masjid al-Musayyab?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that Abu Ja'far (عليه السلام) prayed in Masjid al-Musayyab and that a dried lote tree there was revived after he prepared himself with water beneath it. The report presents a biographical narrative associated with the Imam (عليه السلام) and highlights an extraordinary sign connected to his presence.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Muhammad Bin Hassan, from Abu Hashim Al Ja’fary who said,

‘I prayed Salat along with Abu Ja’farasws (9th Imamasws) in the Masjid Al-Musayyab, and he prayed Salat with us in the place of the Qiblah, straight’. And he mentioned that there was a lotus tree which was in the Masjid had dried up. There weren’t any leaves upon it. So heasws called for the water and prepared (performed Wudou) beneath the lotus tree. So the lotus tree was revived and sprouted leaves and bore (fruit) from its year (season)’.
en.sarwar: 10. Ahmad ibn Idris has narrated from from Muhammad ibn Hassa’n from abu Hashim Ali-Ja‘fari who has said the following.

“Once I prayed with abu Ja‘far (a.s.) in the Mosque of Ali-Musayyib. He lead the prayer with us and as to the direction of Makka he stood up facing straight. He also has said that a berry tree that was in the Mosque had dried up and had no leaves. The Imam (a.s.) asked for water and prepared himself under that tree for prayer. The berry tree came alive with leaves and fruits in that year.”
